sloka: एवमुक्तस्तु हनुमान्राघवेण महात्मना ।वाक्यं विज्ञापयामास परं हर्षमवाप्य च ।। ७.१०८.३५ ॥
transliteration: evamuktastu hanumānrāghaveṇa mahātmanā ।vākyaṁ vijñāpayāmāsa paraṁ harṣamavāpya ca ।। 7.108.35 ॥

translations.english: Having been thus addressed by the great-souled Rama, Hanuman, filled with supreme joy, submitted his reply.
